Basketball club in Copenhagen for kids, teens and adults

We are on Østerbro. Five year olds take their first dribble at Strandvejsskolen. Our men play 3. Division at Svanemøllehallen, and every age in between trains with us during the week. Coach Deng played pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark, and we run camps in all three.

Book a trial

Your first session is free. Bring indoor shoes. Fill this in and we show you your first session right here.

Age groups run from 1 October, so the date decides the team.

We work out the group from the date of birth and show you the next session straight away.

Got it. Check your inbox, your session details are on the way.

Everybody should play

Every kid should be able to play, wherever they are from and whatever their family earns. At five you can start with us.

Start here

Mini starts at 5, and Sparks is for girls 6 to 14. If money is in the way, talk to us. The board can help a family, and it stays private.

Find your team

Go as far as you can

Academy trains up to five days a week. When a player is ready, we pick up the phone.

Camps

All camps, including October and summer

The next camp is the December break. Three days, 50 places, lunch Monday and Tuesday.

Dec 28 to 30 · Hafnia-Hallen

NBA and EuroLeague Pathway Camp, ages 13 to 17

Three days on what NBA, EuroLeague and college coaches look for, led by Tremaine Dalton of the NBA Basketball Schools in Europe. Measured profile, filmed games and a written evaluation. 50 places.

1.795 kr to Sunday 15 November, then 1.995 kr Get the details

Guide to basketball in Copenhagen

  • MiniAges 5 to 9

    Tue + Thu 15:30 to 16:30 at Strandvejsskolen, Sat 11:00 to 12:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By

    See Mini

  • JuniorAges 10 to 12

    Tue + Thu 16:30 to 18:00 at Strandvejsskolen, Sat 11:00 to 12:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By

    See Junior

  • SaturdaysAges 5 to 12, and parents

    One session for kids 5 to 12, 11:00 to 12:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By. Parents join for the last 20 minutes, Family Time. For families who cannot make a weekday afternoon.

    See Saturdays

  • AcademyAges 13 to 19

    Up to five days a week, Monday to Friday. The full week

    See Academy

  • SparksGirls 6 to 14

    Mon 15:30 to 16:30 at Strandvejsskolen, with Big Sisters on court. Girls 15 and up play with the Stevnsgade girls team.

    See Sparks

  • Talata MenMen 18+

    New 3. Division team. Mon 18:45 to 20:15 at Svanemøllehallen, Fri 18:45 to 21:00 at Nørre Fælled Skole. Full 26/27 schedule when you sign up.

    See Men

  • Talata & Co.Adults

    Men and women, 18 and up, every level. Fridays at Svanemøllehallen, food together after.

    See the details
